ex.q: Where do we stand out against rivals?
ex.a: From the Cuvee website: a rooftop terrace over Westgate and State Farm Stadium, two resort style pools with firepits and cabanas, a two story fitness center with yoga and spin, a game room, a game lawn with a putting green, a dog park and a pet spa.

ex.q: Who showed the tour? Pending service requests?
ex.a: Tour agents and service requests live in your property management system, which is not connected to this app. Tours you log in Tour mode are on your desk list.

We cannot see each person’s reason, but here is what they see when they compare you:
  • Broadstone Westgate, Glen 91 and Prose Desert River advertise up to 12 weeks free.
  • Move in cost is $325, the highest of 11 communities.
  • Glen 91 waives app and admin fees on a look and lease.
What wins them back: the rooftop terrace, two pools, game room and pet spa, plus 6 months free parking.

Broadstone Westgate: up to 12 weeks free plus up to $1,000 off, move in by Nov 30. Glen 91: 12 weeks free on 1 bedrooms, 10 on 2 bedrooms, fees waived on look and lease. Prose Desert River: up to 12 weeks free base rent. Ours: up to 11 weeks free plus 6 months free parking.

ex.a: The rivals leasing fastest: Broadstone Westgate (4.6 a week), Prose Desert River (4.4), Springs At Westgate (3.6), Copper Falls (3.4) and Glen 91 (3.2). Cuvee counted 4.8 a week, but 17 of its 24 leases landed on one day, Nov 3.

Our 1 bedroom average asking rent is $1,449 and 2 bedroom $1,725. The plans furthest above market for their size are Champagne A3 and Rose A3.1. Petit Verdot A6 and Malbec B2 are at market and listed longest, so feature them first.
